automated.summary: Six new tests in factory/tests/test_grill_budget.py seed REAL ledger lifecycles rather than synthetic single rows: starting/running/failed, starting/running/succeeded, and standalone starting and running launches. They assert that a failed lifecycle neither counts toward the cap nor blocks the repeat-read guard (the guard refused it before), that a succeeded lifecycle still counts so the budget is not disabled, that a launch in flight counts, that both guards agree on the same collapsed view, and that no new field is written to the delegation ledger.
commands_run: uv run --with pytest --with psutil python -m pytest factory/tests/test_grill_budget.py -q
